title: Dashboards: Streamlit (public demo) and Power BI (local report), both read the same frozen snapshots
rule: Pages, numbers, sources and tolerances are fixed here before any dashboard code exists. Values are never typed into this file or the app: every number is computed from a snapshot, and the verifier recomputes it independently from the raw results files. A change to this file after results are seen must be a separate, explained commit and may not loosen any criterion in phase8_scorecard.json.

definitions.RUL: Remaining useful life: cycles left before the engine fails. Training targets and test truth are capped at 125 cycles.
definitions.interval: MC-dropout 90% interval with rule E scale factors (models/calibration_rule.json): mean +/- k x sd over 100 dropout passes, k switched on predicted RUL <= 50.
definitions.near_failure: Test engines whose true RUL <= 50 cycles.
definitions.RMSE: Root mean squared error of predicted vs true (capped) RUL over the 100 test engines of a dataset, in cycles.
definitions.near_failure_MAE: Mean absolute error over near-failure test engines, in cycles.
definitions.coverage: Share of test engines whose true capped RUL lies inside the 90% interval.
definitions.OEE: Availability x Performance x Quality from summed hours and units (maintenance/simulate.py oee()). Availability = run hours / planned hours; Performance = actual units / ideal units; Quality = good units / actual units. SIMULATED plant: not measured data.
definitions.drift_false_alarm_rate: Phase 7 rule v1: share of clean test runs with a drift test in which at least one sensor was flagged drifted.
definitions.clean_run_flag_rate: Phase 7b rule v2: share of clean replay runs with needs_retraining set (criterion C1, limit 5%, pipeline/phase7b_criteria.json).
definitions.shift: One flow run per dataset per 8-hour shift = one engine cycle.

snapshots.format: CSV, UTF-8, LF line endings, fixed column order, rows sorted by the listed key, floats written with repr (round-trip exact), no timestamps in any file
snapshots.manifest: dashboards/snapshots/manifest.json: per file row count, sha256, run IDs, key; sha256 of every source file used; one data_checksum = sha256 over the sorted (file, sha256) pairs

fleet.csv.rows: one per test engine, FD001 + FD003 (published LSTM, last observed cycle)
fleet.csv.file_source: maintenance/snapshot_decisions_phase6.csv: the published forecasts the Phase 6 plan acted on (point, MC mean/sd, k, bounds, true RUL, flag, risk, outcome)
fleet.csv.db_source: public.fact_alert context = 'snapshot' (rul_low_used and decision_cycle of every flagged engine) and public.fact_prediction at the last cycle (point forecast; rolling MC mean and bounds kept as rolling_* columns)
fleet.csv.correction: Amended after the first export, before any app code (see git log): the spec first named public.fact_prediction as the source, but that table holds Phase 6's rolling forecasts, whose MC passes are a fresh set of draws (maintenance/forecasts.py), so at the last cycle their MC mean/sd differ from the published forecasts the plan used (point forecasts are identical). No criterion changed.
fleet.csv.independent: models/predictions_phase5.csv (FD001) and models/predictions_phase5b.csv (FD003): MC mean/sd, true RUL; bounds rebuilt from rule E k values in models/results_phase5b.json

models.csv.rows: one per dataset x model: Fleet average, Age only, Ridge (168 features), XGBoost (168 features), LSTM (published), CNN
models.csv.independent: RMSE and near-failure MAE recomputed from models/predictions_phase4.csv, predictions_phase5.csv, predictions_phase5b.csv against the RUL column

plan.csv.independent: maintenance/snapshot_decisions_phase6.csv (flagged rows) and maintenance/results_phase6.json snapshot block

oee_machines.csv.rows: one per simulated machine x policy (FD001 + FD003, 3 policies)

oee_policies.csv.rows: per scope (FD001, FD003, pooled) x policy: availability, performance, quality, OEE, failures, planned services, downtime hours, wasted cycles; plus the two pooled OEE gaps with their bootstrap 95% CI
oee_policies.csv.file_source: aggregated from oee_machines.csv with the oee() formula; gaps and CI copied from maintenance/results_phase6.json
oee_policies.csv.independent: re-aggregated from maintenance/machines_phase6.csv with a separate implementation; compared to maintenance/results_phase6.json

monitoring_runs.csv.rows: one per flow run: Phase 7 (rule v1, FD001/FD003) and Phase 7b fresh synchronized + staggered (rule v2, FD002/FD004)
monitoring_runs.csv.db_source: ops.fact_model_health; ops7b_fresh_synchronized / ops7b_fresh_staggered.fact_model_health (columns run_id, dataset, shift, n_labelled, n_scored, rmse, coverage_90, drifted_sensors, needs_retraining, retraining_reasons)
monitoring_runs.csv.file_source: results/phase7/phase7_drift.csv aggregated per run (drift_tested, any_drifted) for Phase 7

app.reads: dashboards/snapshots/ only (no database, no model weights, no network)
app.requirements: app/requirements.txt, exact pins, used by Streamlit Community Cloud and by the clean-install CI job
app.palette: Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe palette; colour never the only carrier of meaning
app.every_metric_has_help: each st.metric carries its definition from this file's definitions block

powerbi.connection: PostgreSQL connector, localhost/pdm, read-only login powerbi_ro (dashboards/create_readonly_role.py); Import mode
tables: dashboards/snapshots/fleet.csv (true RUL is not in the database)
dashboards/snapshots/monitoring_runs.csv (per-run drift result is aggregated from the drift table)
powerbi.pages: same four question pages as the app (fleet, plan, oee, monitoring)
measures: OEE = DIVIDE(run hours, planned hours) x DIVIDE(actual units, ideal units) x DIVIDE(good units, actual units)
Interval coverage = share of engines with true RUL inside [rul_low, rul_high]
Flagged = COUNTROWS(rul_low <= 20) at the last cycle
Retraining flag rate = share of runs with needs_retraining
powerbi.evidence: docs/figures/phase8/powerbi_report.pdf, one PNG per page, and one exported CSV per checked visual in docs/figures/phase8/powerbi_exports/ (Power BI 'Export data'); the .pbix is not committed
powerbi.check: verify_phase8 compares every exported Power BI value with the independent recomputation at displayed precision
